prompt: Vertical frame shot from ground level, the lens nestled low among blades of grass and tilted steeply upward. Tall slender blades of vivid lime-green grass rise into the frame from the bottom and both edges, each blade unnaturally smooth and glossy as if lacquered, with sunlit yellow-lime tips, deep emerald shadows at their bases and tiny round dew droplets clinging along their edges, each droplet holding its own pinpoint of light. Above them a flawless saturated cyan sky deepens to rich royal blue at the very top, crossed by a few thin, feathery white cloud wisps. Large transparent soap bubbles float upward through the frame at different heights and sizes, their thin skins swirling with faint rainbow film of magenta, gold and teal, each topped by a crisp white crescent highlight from the high overhead sun and a softer glint on its lower rim. One big bubble in the lower middle of the frame is razor sharp and works like a curved mirror, holding a tiny warped reflection of the bright meadow and sky; the bubbles farther away melt into soft round circles of blurred light. In the upper left corner a gentle white and pale-cyan sun flare blooms with a few faint circular rings trailing diagonally across the sky. Macro lens, very shallow depth of field, crisp high-key midday light, super saturated clean palette of lime, cyan, aqua and pure white, polished and immaculate like a glossy mid-2000s computer desktop background or an upbeat stock photograph about a bright tomorrow, cheerful to the point of feeling slightly too perfect. No people, no text, no lettering, no logos. Thanks.
